SWEEP.summary: Trigger a compression sweep over the keyspace.
SWEEP.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of keys. Spread across multiple cron ticks under `compression-sweep-max-cpu-pct` pacing; does not block the main thread.

arguments.name: direction
arguments.summary: direction=compress (default) walks every eligible string value and queues it for background compression. direction=decompress walks every compressed value and decompresses it in place; useful as the explicit drain step after disabling the feature.

reply_schema.description: OK if the sweep was queued; an error if a sweep is already in progress or the master switch is off.
